groups.activity: pledge Perrin or New Loka; rank both to Rank 3
groups.meta: 71,000 standing, 1 Forma, 1 Orokin Reactor, ~180,000 cr, per syndicate
groups.mode: pledge whichever first; buy Blade and Handle once both hit Rank 3

rows.label: Centaur Handle
rows.note: 20,000 New Loka standing at Rank 3 Benevolent

conditions: New Loka is allied with Perrin (+50%), so pledging either drags the other up at half rate; the standing pools stay separate.
Perrin is enemy to Steel Meridian (-100%) and opposed to Arbiters of Hexis (-50%).

groups.activity: pledge Hexis or Cephalon Suda; rank to Rank 3, Lawful
groups.mode: switch here only after buying Blade and Handle
conditions: Earning Hexis standing costs Perrin standing at -50%; buy the Blade and Handle before pledging Hexis so Perrin doesn't dip below Rank 3.
The daily standing cap (16,000 plus 500 per Mastery Rank) is shared across all six faction syndicates, so holding two at once doesn't raise the ceiling.
bonuses: Cephalon Suda is allied to Hexis, so pledging Suda instead levels Hexis by proxy if you'd rather keep Suda positive.

disclosures.title: trade instead
disclosures.body: All three parts are tradeable; only the blueprint isn't. The near-unanimous advice is to farm your own aligned syndicate's goods and trade for the parts you can't reach directly, rather than grinding all three syndicates from scratch.

bonuses: Tempered Blade pushes crit chance to 62.5%.
